stories.title: Driver rescued after semi-truck flips over into Coeur d’Alene River
stories.summary: Idaho State Police confirmed to KREM 2 News that the accident occurred at 9 p.m. near mile marker 43 of Coeur d’Alene River Road.

stories.title: Sacajawea Middle School warns that students ‘may have’ been exposed to whooping cough
stories.summary: “Spokane Regional Health District has seen an increased number of whooping cough cases,” the school said in a Friday announcement.

stories.title: Spokane Valley Fire Department will ask voters to approve replacement levy in February
stories.summary: The proposed four-year replacement levy would fund day-to-day operations and critical capital needs for the 2028–2031 period.

stories.title: Idaho Potato Drop officially being hosted in Caldwell; exact location pending
stories.summary: As for the exact location, Phillips said it is between Indian Creek Plaza in the city's downtown and the "Caldwell Event Center area."

stories.title: Post 143 to host community Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The free Thanksgiving dinner is set for Saturday, Nov. 21, from 1-4 p.m. at 1138 E. Poleline Ave.

stories.title: Stevens County Sheriff’s Office arrests man they say plotted to ‘ambush’ law enforcement
stories.summary: A 33-year-old was arrested following a Nov. 17 standoff where he punched holes through his walls and set up "improvised shooting locations."

stories.title: First responders serve up support for Special Olympics
stories.summary: This year, the event was expanded to all area law enforcement agencies and first responders.

stories.title: Okanogan County Sheriff sergeant receives DOJ award for actions during October 2022 murder spree
stories.summary: Sergeant Kristopher Brakebill chased the suspects in a deadly shooting in Keller, even after they shot and injured him.

stories.title: Deadline to dispatch Spokane firefighters pushed to April 2027, but who's responsible for the delay is up for debate
stories.summary: The city and SREC had previously agreed on a January 1 deadline for Spokane to dispatch its own firefighters.

stories.title: Police arrest man connected to dead woman found in Marysville trash bin
stories.summary: The body of Sara Arneklev was discovered in a Marysville trash bin on April 29 by a neighbor.

stories.title: US Forest Service releases records on 1982 'Bigfoot' tracks found in Mill Creek watershed
stories.summary: Investigators checked two sites in the Mill Creek watershed, where the tracks appeared in short stretches.

stories.title: ITD warns Idahoans of new traffic citation scam
stories.summary: The Idaho Transportation Department said a new scam involving phone calls and voicemails claims residents have unpaid traffic citations.
